description: Preview (may change before v0.10.0): Compare architecture at two exact committed Git refs without checking out either ref or changing the worktree. Returns immutable commit IDs plus added/removed edges, cycle and boundary drift, coupling growth, and decision disagreements: edges at the later ref that break a fixmap-deny-imports rule stated by an accepted decision record. Snapshots are cached per exact commit outside the repository.

applyPolicy.description: Apply the repository architecture policy when present (default true)

format.description: Output format: markdown (default) or json, case-insensitive

noCache.description: Rebuild both snapshots instead of reusing the per-commit cache

repo.description: Local Git checkout path (defaults to the MCP server repository)

name: fixmap_history
title: FixMap history
